{{Top|leg}}
A '''cooling chamber''' was a piece of technology. It could be used to store [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]].<ref name="Zorba">''[[Zorba the Hutt's Revenge]]''</ref> Four cooling chambers, filled with [[Meter/Legends|meter]]-long [[cryogenic cylinder]]s, surrounded the [[Power core/Legends|power core]], [[EMS-500|energy capacitors]], and the [[turbolaser pulsor]] of [[Loronar Defense Industries]]' [[MAS-2xB]]. The chambers were designed to prevent the weapon from experiencing a critical meltdown during combat.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
